qa_verdicts.recommended_fix: Increase Character LoRA strength to 0.88 or enable FaceDetailer (denoise=0.32). | Lower Flux guidance to 2.0 and specify directional light source (e.g., 'window side-lighting'). | Reduce Flux guidance from 3.5 -> 2.1, increase iPhone candid LoRA to 0.45, add 0.018 sensor grain. | Trigger MediaPipe hand-mask inpaint pass (denoise=0.45) or crop frame above wrist before I2V. | Lower Character LoRA weight from 1.0 -> 0.82; portrait-heavy LoRA datasets inflate head ratio on wide shots. | Mask background signage with Gaussian depth blur or inpaint readable text via Flux Fill. | Remove 'bokeh/portrait' tokens; enforce 'IMG_XXXX.HEIC, 24mm f/1.78 deep depth of field'.
